hook: GPT-6.2 Astra beat Google's code golf records.
hookText: Astra tops Google's code golf records

beats.say: The benchmark revives 32 problems from a code golf contest played at Google in 2015, across eight languages, with each model given 30 minutes per problem.
Models are scored on byte counts, not just whether the code works. A solution ten percent longer scores 82.6 percent, and one twice as long scores 25 percent.
GPT-6.2 Astra is the first model to beat the records set by Google's own code golfers, more than a decade after the contest.
